question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the underlined part of the sentence:
By the time we reached the station, the train __left__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence involves two actions in the past. The action of the train leaving occurred **before** we reached the station.
 
• In such cases, the **past perfect tense** is used to indicate the action that happened earlier.
 
• The correct structure is: **By the time + past simple, past perfect.**
